question: Compare Salesforce and HubSpot on AI product announcements

findings.claim: Salesforce describes its AI product programme.
findings.evidence: Salesforce states that its AI product programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
findings.title: Salesforce platform overview

findings.claim: HubSpot describes its AI product programme.
findings.evidence: HubSpot states that its AI product programme is organised around partner platforms.
findings.title: HubSpot platform overview

findings.evidence: Both Salesforce and HubSpot report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
findings.title: Partnership summary

findings.claim: An analyst note compares the two approaches.
findings.evidence: The note contrasts Salesforce's in-house delivery with HubSpot's partner-led model.
findings.title: Analyst note

findings.claim: Salesforce discloses investment in AI product capability.
findings.evidence: Salesforce discloses continued investment in AI product training and certification.
findings.title: Salesforce investment disclosure

findings.claim: HubSpot discloses investment in AI product capability.
findings.evidence: HubSpot discloses continued investment in AI product delivery centres.
findings.title: HubSpot investment disclosure

sections.heading: How Salesforce and HubSpot organise AI product
sections.body: Salesforce runs AI product through a dedicated unit, while HubSpot organises the same work around partner platforms. The two structures lead to different delivery models.

sections.heading: Partnerships and investment
sections.body: Both Salesforce and HubSpot report platform partnerships, and both disclose continued investment in AI product capability, though in different places.

claims.text: Salesforce delivers AI product work through a dedicated business unit.
HubSpot organises AI product work around partner platforms.
Both Salesforce and HubSpot report multi-year platform partnerships.
Salesforce and HubSpot both disclose continued AI product investment.
